hypothesis: Strengthen threshold calibration to support high direct-eval reliance
rationale: With DIRECT_EVAL_WEIGHT at 0.90, the final decisions are extremely sensitive to the chosen threshold. Expanding the calibration data fraction (0.15 -> 0.20) and allowing deeper world evaluation per spot (150 -> 200 max worlds) should produce a more robust threshold, avoiding bottlenecking the highly trusted direct evaluator with a poorly calibrated cutoff.
